items: Each location's rating and recent reviews are what nearby searchers see first, so reputation drives discovery and revenue store by store.
Google's prominence factor rests on review count, score and recency, so locations with more and fresher reviews appear in the Map Pack more often.
A few low-rated stores pull down how guests see the whole brand, get buried in search results and cost more in service recovery later.
Aggregate reviews across platforms but read them store by store, reply quickly, set alerts for negative trends and use location trends for coaching and resource decisions.
Momos helps multi-location brands monitor and reply to reviews at every location and turn review data into fixes for operators.
